about: The queries `pnpm eval:search` runs against the live sources, with the papers a good search for each one should find. A mustInclude entry is a DOI that was checked (Crossref or DataCite) to resolve to the title written next to it. Nothing in the ranking code mentions any of these queries or papers: they only measure it. The `check` field names the automatic check run on that query (see search.eval.ts).
